record.question: The procedure of withdrawal of pending Excise and Narcotics cases should not be resorted except in the following cases (i) Cases in which during the course of the proceeding in court it has been found that wrong persons have been sent up owing to obvious mistake during investigation. (ii) Cases which are so weak and are bound almost certainly to end in acquittal and which in the first instance should not have been sent to Court.
